stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The jacket had not only kept him warm.”?
options: A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
Saving water was serious work, but the song made the message simple enough for everyone to carry.
In danger, the best message is the one that actually reaches the person who needs it.
It had also carried a simple message from one person to another: help does not have to stop with the person who receives it.
